name: Saudi Arabia
description: Follow Saudi Arabia, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Saudi Arabia's critical pipeline remains shut as oil prices soar
changes.summary: The East-West pipeline in Saudi Arabia remains shut after a drone attack last week, a major hit to the supply of oil flowing out of the country. Saudi Arabia blamed the attack on Iranian-backed militias in Iraq. Threadneedle founder Ann Berry joins to discuss.

changes.title: Oil Prices Jump on Energy Supply Worries
changes.summary: Traders sold oil futures on concerns that energy supplies from the Persian Gulf would be further diminished by a drone attack on a critical pipeline in Saudi Arabia.

changes.title: Saudi Arabia has few options as it faces mounting threats from Iran and its allies
changes.summary: A lightning advance by Houthi rebels threatens a crucial Red Sea shipping route. Drone attacks blamed on Iraqi militias have forced the closure of a major pipeline, and Iran is still disrupting the Strait of Hormuz.

changes.title: Saudi Arabia’s Oil ‘Lifeline’ Was Attacked. Here’s What to Know.
changes.summary: A drone attack from Iraq forced Saudi Arabia to close its East-West pipeline, the kingdom said, threatening a key workaround to Iran’s Persian Gulf blockade.

changes.title: Saudi Arabia forced to shut down crucial Red Sea pipeline after attacks
changes.summary: The Iran-backed Houthi militia captured a strategic Red Sea port city this week. NPR's Scott Simon talks to April Longley Alley of the Washington Institute.

changes.title: Saudi Oil Exports Plunge as Spread of War Shuts Off Shipping Routes
changes.summary: With few good options for safely shipping oil, Saudi Arabia’s exports have fallen to a 13-year low.

changes.title: Oil nears $100 after Saudi Arabia says energy infrastructure was attacked
changes.summary: Brent, the international oil benchmark, touched $99 a barrel after Saudi Arabia reported an attack on energy assets that caused temporary pauses in operations.

changes.title: Saudi Arabia and Yemen’s Houthis Edge Back to the Brink of War
changes.summary: The Saudi authorities said dozens were injured in attacks by the Iran-backed militia and vowed to retaliate.

changes.title: Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia ignite fires at oil facilities and wound 73 people
changes.summary: The attacks come after weeks of escalating clashes between the Houthis and Saudi-backed government forces in Yemen, which shattered a four-year truce in the country's civil war. (Image credit: AP).

changes.title: Houthis strike Saudi Arabian cities in significant expansion of Middle East war
changes.summary: Riyadh says it will retaliate after overnight attacks by Iran-backed Yemen group on oil facilities wound more than 70 Yemen’s Iran-backed Houthis have attacked four cities in Saudi Arabia, wounding more than 70 people and setting oil installations ablaze in what appeared to be a significant expansion of the Middle East.
